name: Exeggutor
description: When they work together, Exeggutor’s three heads can put out powerful psychic energy. Cloudy days make this Pokémon sluggish.

moves.name: Stomp
moves.description: The user attacks by stomping on the target with a big foot. This may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Absorb
moves.description: A nutrient-draining attack. The user's HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target.

moves.name: Mega Drain
moves.description: A nutrient-draining attack. The user's HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target.

moves.name: Leech Seed
moves.description: A seed is planted on the target. It steals some HP from the target every turn.

moves.name: Solar Beam
moves.description: The user gathers light on the first turn, then blasts a bundled beam on the next turn.

moves.name: Confusion
moves.description: The target is hit with a weak telekinetic force to inflict damage. This may also confuse the target.

moves.name: Hypnosis
moves.description: The user employs hypnotic suggestion to make the target fall asleep.

moves.name: Reflect
moves.description: A wondrous wall of light is put up to reduce damage from physical moves for five turns.

moves.name: Giga Drain
moves.description: A nutrient-draining attack. The user's HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target.

moves.name: Synthesis
moves.description: The user restores its own HP. The amount of HP regained varies with the weather.

moves.name: Uproar
moves.description: The user attacks in an uproar for three turns. During that time, no Pokémon can fall asleep.

moves.name: Extrasensory
moves.description: The user attacks with an odd, unseeable power. This may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Bullet Seed
moves.description: The user attacks by forcefully shooting seeds at the target. This move hits two to five times in a row.

moves.name: Worry Seed
moves.description: A seed that causes worry is planted on the target. It prevents sleep by making the target's Ability Insomnia.

moves.name: Seed Bomb
moves.description: The user attacks by slamming a barrage of hard-shelled seeds down on the target from above.

moves.name: Leaf Storm
moves.description: The user whips up a storm of leaves around the target. The recoil from this move harshly lowers the user's Sp. Atk stat.

moves.name: Wood Hammer
moves.description: The user slams its rugged body into the target to attack. This also damages the user quite a lot.

moves.name: Psyshock
moves.description: The user materializes an odd psychic wave to attack the target. This move deals physical damage.

moves.name: Swords Dance
moves.description: A frenetic dance to uplift the fighting spirit. This sharply boosts the user's Attack stat.

moves.name: Body Slam
moves.description: The user attacks by dropping onto the target with its full body weight. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

moves.name: Take Down
moves.description: A reckless full-body charge attack for slamming into the target. This also damages the user a little.

moves.name: Double-Edge
moves.description: A reckless life-risking tackle in which the user rushes the target. This also damages the user quite a lot.

moves.name: Psybeam
moves.description: The target is attacked with a peculiar ray. This may also confuse the target.

moves.name: Hyper Beam
moves.description: The target is attacked with a powerful beam. The user can't move on the next turn.

moves.name: Low Kick
moves.description: A powerful low kick that makes the target fall over. The heavier the target, the greater the move's power.

moves.name: Solar Beam
moves.description: The user gathers light on the first turn, then blasts a bundled beam on the next turn.

moves.name: Earthquake
moves.description: The user sets off an earthquake that strikes every Pokémon around it.

moves.name: Psychic
moves.description: The target is hit with a strong telekinetic force to inflict damage. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Light Screen
moves.description: A wondrous wall of light is put up to reduce damage from special moves for five turns.

moves.name: Reflect
moves.description: A wondrous wall of light is put up to reduce damage from physical moves for five turns.

moves.name: Rest
moves.description: The user goes to sleep for two turns. This fully restores the user's HP and cures any status conditions.

moves.name: Substitute
moves.description: The user creates a substitute for itself using some of its own HP. The substitute serves as the user's decoy.

moves.name: Thief
moves.description: The user attacks and steals the target's held item simultaneously. The user can't steal anything if it already holds an item.

moves.name: Curse
moves.description: A move that has different effects depending on whether the user is a Ghost type or not.

moves.name: Protect
moves.description: This move enables the user to protect itself from all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

moves.name: Sludge Bomb
moves.description: The user hurls unsanitary sludge at the target to inflict damage. This may also poison the target.

moves.name: Giga Drain
moves.description: A nutrient-draining attack. The user's HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target.

moves.name: Endure
moves.description: The user endures any attack with at least 1 HP. This move's chance of failing rises if used in succession.

moves.name: Sleep Talk
moves.description: The user randomly uses one of the moves it knows. This move can only be used while the user is asleep.

moves.name: Sunny Day
moves.description: The user intensifies the sun for five turns, powering up Fire-type attacks. The sunlight also lowers the power of Water-type attacks.

moves.name: Psych Up
moves.description: The user hypnotizes itself into copying any stat change made by the target.

moves.name: Future Sight
moves.description: Two turns after this move is used, a hunk of psychic energy attacks the target.

moves.name: Uproar
moves.description: The user attacks in an uproar for three turns. During that time, no Pokémon can fall asleep.

moves.name: Facade
moves.description: This move's power is doubled if the user is poisoned, burned, or paralyzed.

moves.name: Helping Hand
moves.description: The user assists an ally by boosting the power of that ally's attack.

moves.name: Trick
moves.description: The user catches the target off guard and swaps the target's held item with its own.

moves.name: Skill Swap
moves.description: The user employs its psychic power to exchange Abilities with the target.

moves.name: Imprison
moves.description: If opposing Pokémon know any move also known by the user, they are prevented from using it.

moves.name: Bullet Seed
moves.description: The user attacks by forcefully shooting seeds at the target. This move hits two to five times in a row.

moves.name: Magical Leaf
moves.description: The user scatters curious leaves that chase the target. This attack never misses.

moves.name: Calm Mind
moves.description: The user quietly focuses its mind and calms its spirit to boost its Sp. Atk and Sp. Def stats.

moves.name: Gravity
moves.description: Enables Flying types or Pokémon with the Levitate Ability to be hit by Ground-type moves for five turns. Moves that involve flying can't be used.

moves.name: Seed Bomb
moves.description: The user attacks by slamming a barrage of hard-shelled seeds down on the target from above.

moves.name: Energy Ball
moves.description: The user draws power from nature and fires it at the target. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Giga Impact
moves.description: The user charges at the target using every bit of its power. The user can't move on the next turn.

moves.name: Zen Headbutt
moves.description: The user focuses its willpower to its head and attacks the target. This may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Trick Room
moves.description: The user creates a bizarre area in which slower Pokémon get to move first for five turns.

moves.name: Leaf Storm
moves.description: The user whips up a storm of leaves around the target. The recoil from this move harshly lowers the user's Sp. Atk stat.

moves.name: Grass Knot
moves.description: The user snares the target with grass and trips it. The heavier the target, the greater the move's power.

moves.name: Psyshock
moves.description: The user materializes an odd psychic wave to attack the target. This move deals physical damage.

moves.name: Stored Power
moves.description: The user attacks the target with stored power. The more the user's stats are boosted, the greater the move's power.

moves.name: Bulldoze
moves.description: The user strikes everything around it by stomping down on the ground. This lowers the Speed stats of those hit.

moves.name: Grassy Terrain
moves.description: The user turns the ground into Grassy Terrain for five turns. This restores the HP of Pokémon on the ground a little every turn and powers up Grass-type moves.

moves.name: Psychic Terrain
moves.description: This protects Pokémon on the ground from priority moves and powers up Psychic-type moves for five turns.

moves.name: Stomping Tantrum
moves.description: Driven by frustration, the user attacks the target. This move's power is doubled if the user's previous move failed.

moves.name: Expanding Force
moves.description: The user attacks the target with its psychic power. When the ground is Psychic Terrain, this move's power is boosted and it damages all opposing Pokémon.

moves.name: Grassy Glide
moves.description: Gliding on the ground, the user attacks the target. This move always goes first on Grassy Terrain.

moves.name: Tera Blast
moves.description: If the user has Terastallized, it unleashes energy of its Tera Type. This move inflicts damage using the Attack or Sp. Atk stat—whichever is higher for the user.

moves.name: Psychic Noise
moves.description: The user attacks the target with unpleasant sound waves. For two turns, the target is prevented from recovering HP through moves, Abilities, or held items.
